note: Shipped constants for tret water accounting. See docs/water-methodology.md. Consumption (evaporated), not withdrawal.

cloud.label: Site WUE (cooling water)
cloud.source: LBNL 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (Shehabi et al., Dec 2024)
cloud.note: US fleet average. The 176 TWh denominator is facility energy, not IT energy, so the ratio leans low when applied per IT kWh.

local.label: Site WUE (local deployment)
local.source: tret default: workstation or on-prem hardware has no evaporative cooling
local.note: Set your own site WUE if local models run in an evaporatively cooled room.

grid_water.label: Grid water (electricity generation)
grid_water.source: WRI 2020 (Reig et al.), world generation-weighted average, Table 4
grid_water.note: Generation only; excludes transmission losses and fuel-chain water. Hydropower reservoir evaporation is fully allocated to electricity.

band.label: Uncertainty band
band.source: tret judgment band (central / 3 to central x 3)
band.note: Judgment band, not a confidence interval.
